corrections.finding: Seatings, columns and bi-folding pairings all match (TWENTY-TWO line 740; Exhibit ONE's four-cycling table and bi-foldings 1-9-8-16, 4-13-5-12, 2-15-7-10, 3-11-6-14); no causer/defender laying, no reference-prior/rate-now laying, no session, source or history. Six things to mend. (1) 'installed as a thing' is an -ed clocking (Natural Explaining 3.5) and parts from the living file's own word: 'a ghost is one momentary's form, installing it as an existing thing'; re-said with installing. (2) 'at two seats' is the released noun seat (Natural Naming 2.4: 'a seat is a certifier over a coupling, and none is'); the living files hold seating and seats-as-verb plainly, so re-said as 'at two of Exhibit ONE's numbers'. (3) The source scopes the ghost sentence to the carbon registry's entries ('At this Registry's entries, by the seatings'); the item says it of every ghost, a claim stronger than its source; the scope is restored, and the source's unscoped listing of the ten at four-cycling's four by their unchangeable names is carried. (4) Numbers dropped: the bi-folding names 1-9-8-16, 4-13-5-12, 2-15-7-10, 3-11-6-14; eight noughts and two with no seating of their own; eleven, seven, eleven and five at the four; eighteen and sixteen in the two pairings. All restored. (5) The source's 'Four entries with two names' paragraph (four of the thirty-four carry a hardness's name and a conserving relation's name, seat at now-existing or same-existing by the second, and are of that moment under each, with TWENTY-TWO's 'a naming that disagrees with its unchangeable thing is an observing of its own') is dropped whole; carried, its entry numbers and the session's choice of name leaving. (6) 'a registry's forty-four observings' points at the session's own file; re-said as forty-four observings at a carbon chain. The fold-to-four by builds stays out, held at TWENTY-TWO line 742; the pass-7 opening ('observing is distinguishing a same-existing...') stays out, the session's own saying and no living file's.

fixed.section: 2.3 Ten unchangeables locate the kind of still
fixed.text: The four ghosts by four-cycling, an explaining. Resolving the Hard Problem Registry seats each of its ten unchangeables at two of Exhibit ONE's numbers, its name with now and the same name eight up with next: an opening fixing as a place at 1 and 9, an observing fixing from behind at 2 and 10, a two-way fixing to one side at 3 and 11, a sequencing fixing to one beat at 4 and 12, a middle fixing as an end and a between fixing as a cut at 5 and 13, a completing fixing as a last at 6 and 14, a parity fixing as a magnitude and a rate fixing as a value at 7 and 15, a same-existing fixing as a store at 8 and 16. Four-cycling's four are Exhibit ONE's columns, 1, 5, 9, 13 next-existing, 2, 6, 10, 14 now-existing, 3, 7, 11, 15 prior-existing, 4, 8, 12, 16 same-existing. By the seatings the ten are at four-cycling's four: at prior-existing a two-way fixing to one side, a parity fixing as a magnitude and a rate fixing as a value; at now-existing an observing fixing from behind and a completing fixing as a last; at next-existing an opening fixing as a place, a middle fixing as an end and a between fixing as a cut; at same-existing a same-existing fixing as a store and a sequencing fixing to one beat. A ghost is one momentary's form, installing it as an existing thing, and at a carbon chain's entries, by the seatings, a ghost at prior-existing is a rate, a magnitude or a side, installing it as an existing thing; at now-existing a first behind or a last; at next-existing a place, an end or a cut; at same-existing a store or a beat; and each ghost is one name at two of Exhibit ONE's numbers, with now and with next. The four pair as Exhibit ONE's bi-foldings pair, next with same, 1-9-8-16 and 4-13-5-12, and now with prior, 2-15-7-10 and 3-11-6-14. At a carbon chain, of forty-four observings eight are noughts with no unchangeable, and two carry names with no seating of their own, an instrument's own coupling and a reference fixing unchangeable, and stand apart; thirty-four have an unchangeable with a seating, eleven at prior-existing, seven at now-existing, eleven at next-existing and five at same-existing, and each thing a field holds fixed is of the moment its unchangeable seats at, thirty-four of thirty-four. Four of the thirty-four carry two names, a field's hardness sentence's and its conserving relation's, and are at their moment by the hardness's: a temporal order and a genealogy each a two-way fixing to one side and an observing fixing from behind, a master sequence maintained a completing fixing as a last and a same-existing fixing as a store, area and topology conserved across events a middle fixing as an end and a same-existing fixing as a store; with the conserving relation's name the first two seat at now-existing and the second two at same-existing, and each is of that moment, the two names standing at each of the four, as Resolving the Hard Problem Registry has it, a naming that disagrees with its unchangeable thing is an observing of its own. The eighteen at prior-existing and now-existing are those whose field word is a rate, a constant, an order, a first behind or a limit, and the sixteen at next-existing and same-existing those whose field word is a selection at a site, a cut, a boundary, a store or a code, each in one pairing and none in both, thirty-four of thirty-four.
